title: The Episode About the Wrestling Bout Between Miri Singh And Sangat Singh

blocks.text: Violence follows the failed settlement, and the Khalsa takes control of the Bandai seat by force, placing Mani Singh upon the gaddi that had been contested.
What began as a doctrinal dispute is now resolved through institution, office, and physical possession of authority.
Mani Singh is the strongest anchor because his installation marks the restored order.
